verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ذَوَاتِ ٱلْأَوْتَارِ» عَلَى «ٱلْقَرَارِ». مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ يَارَبُّ، لَا تُوَبِّخْنِي بِغَضَبِكَ، وَلَا تُؤَدِّبْنِي بِغَيْظِكَ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

verses.ar: ٱرْحَمْنِي يَارَبُّ لِأَنِّي ضَعِيفٌ. ٱشْفِنِي يَارَبُّ لِأَنَّ عِظَامِي قَدْ رَجَفَتْ،
verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I [am] weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

verses.ar: وَنَفْسِي قَدِ ٱرْتَاعَتْ جِدًّا. وَأَنْتَ يَارَبُّ، فَحَتَّى مَتَى؟
verses.kjv: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.web: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?

verses.ar: عُدْ يَارَبُّ. نَجِّ نَفْسِي. خَلِّصْنِي مِنْ أَجْلِ رَحْمَتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.web: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي ٱلْمَوْتِ ذِكْرُكَ. فِي ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ مَنْ يَحْمَدُكَ؟
verses.kjv: For in death [there is] no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.web: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

verses.ar: تَعِبْتُ فِي تَنَهُّدِي. أُعَوِّمُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ سَرِيرِي بِدُمُوعِي. أُذَوِّبُ فِرَاشِي.
verses.kjv: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.web: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

verses.ar: سَاخَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ عَيْنِي. شَاخَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ مُضَايِقِيَّ.
verses.kjv: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.web: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

verses.ar: اُبْعُدُوا عَنِّي يَا جَمِيعَ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ قَدْ سَمِعَ صَوْتَ بُكَائِي.
verses.kjv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.web: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.ar: سَمِعَ ٱلرَّبُّ تَضَرُّعِي. ٱلرَّبُّ يَقْبَلُ صَلَاتِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
verses.web: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

verses.ar: جَمِيعُ أَعْدَائِي يُخْزَوْنَ وَيَرْتَاعُونَ جِدًّا. يَعُودُونَ وَيُخْزَوْنَ بَغْتَةً.
verses.kjv: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return [and] be ashamed suddenly.
verses.web: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
